signin.body: An account keeps your settings in sync across devices. Prices and the plan work without one.

signin.privacyLink: What we store and how to delete it

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: You can use {{app}} without an account. Your settings and plan are kept on this device.
privacy.p2: If you sign in, we store your email address and your settings (region, usual kilos, budget, tracked goods, theme, language and alert choice) so they follow you to other devices.
privacy.p3: If you switch on price drop alerts, we store this device's push address with your region, tracked goods and language so we can send the alert. No account is needed for alerts.
privacy.p4: Delete your account from Settings › Account to remove your email, settings and alerts. Switching alerts off removes this device's push address.
privacy.p5: Prices come from public Department of Agriculture reports.
